items.title: Emile Barnes Interview, 1962-01-03
items.q: Which was Tony Marullo down there. Who's that now? Tony Marullo. You know him, Nick?

ctx.x: And how did he play himself? Do he play pretty much like he does now?

Yeah. Same scene. When you see Thomas doesn't work hard in the band, you know. He's a little bit cool. He comes up strong all the time. He puts a car and takes a rest. You know, see, when he's playing. And I left from Thomas and I started waiting down to Grand Island. Which was Tony Marullo down there. Who's that now? Tony Marullo. You know him, Nick?
That's the guy that owned the place? Yeah.
